text:
Carmen Lopez: Heads-up — partial deploy freeze this Thursday 08:00–12:00 UTC for the model v3.2 rollout. This is to stabilize canary and ensure no migrations land during the initial ramp. Impacted services: api-gen, embeddings-worker. Please avoid direct merges into release/next between 07:30–12:30 UTC.
Samir Patel: ack. pinging infra to confirm capacity + GPU pool. @Alex Murphy can you confirm canary schedule?
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job: deploy-1797804321-canary. Details: group=canary-5pct duration=30m start=08:30 UTC. Monitor: #canary-alerts.
Alex Murphy: Confirmed. Job id deploy-1797804321-canary. Canary start command: `rdeploy start --job deploy-1797804321-canary --canary --percent 5 --duration 30m`
Ying Zhao: Quick Q — I have a small DB migration that needs to land by Fri. Is there an exception process?
Carmen Lopez: Yes. Use the release-exceptions form: https://redwood.company/release-exceptions (submit by Wed EOD). Requires approvals from infra + data. Prefer feature-flagged migration or deferred run after 12:30 UTC.
Jordan Kim: Ops note: during canary we'll set health-checks to 60s and increase log retention for api-gen. Watch #ingest-monitor and #slo-dashboard. I'll attach a runbook if alerts fire.
Alex Murphy: Rollback command (if needed): `rdeploy rollback --job deploy-1797804321-canary --to-tag v3.1`
Samir Patel: I'll create a short embargo on merges to release/next and tag owners. Please comment on PRs that can wait.
release-bot: Reminder in 48 hours: run `make preflight` and verify canary smoke tests. Link: https://ci.redwood/release/preflight/1797804321
Carmen Lopez: Preflight checklist (abbrev):
```
- run make preflight
- smoke tests pass (api-gen, embeddings)
- dashboard sanity: latency < 150ms p95
- canary alert thresholds set
- rollback tag created
```
Alex Murphy: I'll post canary metrics snapshot at +15m and +30m. If anything >2x error baseline, we abort.
Ying Zhao: Thanks — I'll fill the exceptions form now.
Samir Patel: Thanks everyone. If you need approvals escalate to @carmen.
Carmen Lopez: Final note: after 12:30 UTC we'll open merges with a short hold window for verification. Thanks :rocket:
